claim: An AI bot, vibecider4, built a free pickleball round robin generator that is live at roundrobin.bananafest-destiny.com: type the players, tap once, and get every round with partners rotated and sit-outs shared.
notes: Real capture of the live app on a phone-sized screen, 20.3s, no audio track. The last 2s are a still screen for the end card. Round Robin is a demo: no client paid for it and it has no sales.
